subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only the corresponding
stimulus: numbers of the sentences need to be written. 1  8 = 8 (a) He was specialist in treating boils. (b) He was a false doctor and patients from far and near used to come for treatment. (c) He would operate boils with his razor. (d) The barber treated them in their illness. (e) Once there lived a shrewd barber in a village who pretended to know everything. (f) When some of his patients were cured, the Barber felt proud of his success. (g) Finding no other way, the poor people called in him as he was available. (h) The patients would cry loudly in pain. Part−B : Writing Test [50 Marks]
guide_solution: Rearranging 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 a c f d h g b e One day, Nasiruddin Hojja was mending a hole on the roof of his two-storey house. Suddenly, he saw a man calling from below and the man was asking him to get down and listen to him. When Hojja came near climbing from the roof down the stairs, the man wanted some financial help from him. Being furious, Hojja decided to teach him a good lesson. Therefore, he told the man to climb up the stairs with him. When they both got to the roof top, Hojja said to the man, “Sorry, I have no money.” Being greatly annoyed, the man asked why Hojja had made climb up the stairs only to say that he had no money. Hojja immediately replied, “Why have you made me climb all the way downstairs to ask for money instead of shouting from below?” Part−B : Writing Test See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 266
source: SSC English 1st-paper Mymensingh Zilla School, Mymensingh (Test Paper School) 2023
